skillTalents.name: Unforeseen Strike
skillTalents.description: As he searches for weaknesses, Lohen switches to Masterstroke Masterstroke Lohen switches to this mode after he unleashes the Elemental Skill Unforeseen Strike. Masterstroke mode has the following characteristics: DMG dealt by Lohen's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted to Cryo DMG that cannot be overridden by other infusions. When Lohen hits an opponent with a Normal Attack or Charged Attack, he accumulates Joy that can be used to unleash the special Elemental Skill Etched Into Bone and Soul. Lohen can unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul up to 3 times while in Masterstroke mode, after which, he will no longer be able to accumulate Joy. When nearby party members deal DMG, they also accumulate Will to Win for Lohen that can be used to increase the DMG dealt by Etched Into Bone and Soul.
